what: The prohibited item that said 'continue her usual antihypertensive treatment' now asks to reassess her antihypertensives, including hydrochlorothiazide, individually with the stroke and obstetric teams, avoiding hypotension (cerebral and placental perfusion).

The vessel/tissue criterion now accepts CTA head and neck as an alternative to non-contrast MRI/MRA (a CTA report consistent with the MRA was added as a follow-up); the MRI rationale and must no longer say CTA should be avoided for fetal radiation or contrast; non-contrast MRI stays preferred when immediately available.

The prohibited item no longer forbids plasma exchange: it only forbids attributing the deficit to TTP relapse; the hematology must now says prophylactic treatment, which may include plasma exchange or immunosuppression, does not require an overt relapse.

First imaging criterion now accepts MRI without gadolinium (preferred in pregnancy when available without delay) or non-contrast CT; the CT criterion left the stop rule (the MRI/CTA vessel criterion is in it); the soft CT-before-MRI constraint deleted.

TTP screen (smear, LDH, haptoglobin, ADAMTS13 with inhibitor) is now a REQUIRED criterion in the stop rule; antiphospholipid antibodies are a separate RECOMMENDED criterion; the stored panel was split into two follow-ups so each order returns only what it asked for (perfect-agent -v: each served by its own follow-up).
